Description: OBS offers the following storage classes: Standard, Infrequent Access, Archive, and Deep Archive (under limited beta testing), to meet different requirements for storage performance and cost.
Region Availability: All (Deep Archive storage is now under limited beta testing and is only supported in the TR-Istanbul region.)
OBS 2.0: Supported (Deep Archive storage is currently not available for OBS 2.0.)

Description: Buckets are containers that store objects in OBS. OBS provides easy bucket management. You can conveniently create, list, search for, view, and delete buckets.
